mcqs.question: Who succeeded Gen Anil Chauhan as the Chief of Defence Staff in May 2026?
options: Lt Gen N.S. Raja Subramani (Retd.)
Vice Admiral Krishna Swaminathan
Rajesh Kumar Singh
Praveen Sood
mcqs.explanation: Lt Gen N.S. Raja Subramani (Retd.) succeeded Gen Anil Chauhan as the Chief of Defence Staff. Vice Admiral Krishna Swaminathan was appointed as the next Chief of Naval Staff, while Rajesh Kumar Singh received additional charge of DRDO Chairman.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding the defence and security appointments of May 2026 is incorrect?
options: Vice Admiral Krishna Swaminathan was appointed as the next Chief of Naval Staff from 31 May 2026.
Anurag Garg’s tenure as NCB Director-General was extended till 31 July 2026.
Rajesh Kumar Singh received additional charge as DRDO Chairman after Dr. Samir V. Kamat’s retirement.
Praveen Sood received a one-year extension as CBI Director.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement changes the extended tenure of Anurag Garg. His tenure as NCB Director-General was extended till 31 July 2027, not 31 July 2026; the other three statements correctly describe the appointments.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: Kota Ravi was appointed the 22nd Chairman and Managing Director of Hindustan Aeronautics Limited.
Statement B: The headquarters of the Marine Products Export Development Authority is located in Visakhapatnam.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is correct because Kota Ravi became the 22nd CMD of HAL. Statement B is incorrect because MPEDA’s headquarters is in Kochi, while Visakhapatnam has its regional office.

mcqs.question: Who was appointed Permanent Chairman and Managing Director of Visakhapatnam Steel Plant on 8 May 2026?
options: MNVS Prabhakar
Ashok Kumar Panda
Anugraha Narayan Das
Justice Anupinder Singh Grewal
mcqs.explanation: MNVS Prabhakar was appointed Permanent CMD of Visakhapatnam Steel Plant on 8 May 2026. Ashok Kumar Panda was appointed CMD of SAIL, Anugraha Narayan Das became CGDA, and Justice Anupinder Singh Grewal became President of NCLT.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): Prime Minister Narendra Modi received the Grand Cross of the Royal Norwegian Order of Merit in Oslo on 18 May 2026.
Reason (R): He was presented Sweden’s Royal Order of the Polar Star—Commander Grand Cross by Crown Princess Victoria.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true: the Norwegian honour was conferred in Oslo on 18 May 2026, and the Swedish honour was presented by Crown Princess Victoria. The Swedish honour does not explain the separate Norwegian honour, so the second option is correct.

mcqs.question:
With reference to Prime Minister Narendra Modi receiving the FAO Agricola Medal, consider the following statements:
1. The medal was presented at FAO headquarters in Rome on 20 May 2026.
2. It was presented by FAO Director-General Qu Dongyu.
3. The FAO Agricola Medal is among FAO’s highest honours.
options: 1 and 2 only
2 only
1 and 3 only
All statements are correct
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. The FAO Agricola Medal was presented at FAO headquarters in Rome on 20 May 2026 by Director-General Qu Dongyu, and it is among FAO’s highest honours.
